description: Use SHVL in ChatGPT to review your credit-control brief, receivables position and overdue cases from the latest data in your signed-in SHVL workspace. SHVL reads imported sales-invoice and receivables-payment records. It does not report bank balance, total cash flow, profit or runway, and it cannot send reminders or change accounting records.
